hook: Your phone can film a ceiling fan spinning backwards.
title: Your ceiling fan can spin backwards on camera
description:
Film a spinning fan or wheel with any phone and it can look slow, frozen or even reversed. It is the wagon-wheel effect: video is made of still frames, and the blades move just far enough between them to fool you. Try it right now.

#Shorts #TryThis #Phone
comment_prompt: Did your fan go backwards? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your phone can film a ceiling fan spinning backwards.
scenes.headline: Fan Spins Backwards

scenes.narration: Switch on your fan and film it.
scenes.headline: Film Your Fan

scenes.narration: Watch: the blades can slow, stop, or reverse.
scenes.headline: Slow, Stop, Reverse

scenes.narration: The fan is not changing direction at all.
scenes.headline: It Never Reversed

scenes.narration: Video is just still frames, many per second.
scenes.headline: Just Still Frames

scenes.narration: Your brain links them and sees backwards motion.
scenes.headline: Your Brain Is Fooled

scenes.narration: It is called the wagon-wheel effect.
scenes.headline: Wagon-Wheel Effect

scenes.narration: So your fan never reversed, only the video.
scenes.headline: Only The Video

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: planes landing below sea level.
scenes.headline: Tomorrow
